mapper.select:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_details WHERE order_status = '대기') AS waitingCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_details WHERE order_status = '승인') AS approvedCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_details WHERE order_status = '거절') AS rejectedCount
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_details ( order_quantity, supply_price, manufacture_at, store_at , app_at, order_status, order_price, reject_reason, current_quantity, order_id, ingredient_id ) VALUES ( #{orderQuantity}, #{supplyPrice}, NULL, NULL, NULL, '대기', #{orderPrice}, NULL, 0, #{orderId}, #{ingredientId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE order_details SET order_status = #{orderStatus}, app_at = NOW(), reject_reason = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = '거절' THEN #{rejectReason} ELSE NULL END WHERE order_detail_id = #{orderDetailId} AND order_status = '대기'
mapper.select: SELECT od.order_detail_id AS orderDetailId, od.ingredient_id AS ingredientId, od.order_quantity AS orderQuantity, i.ingredient_name AS ingredientName, i.order_unit AS orderUnit, od.supply_price AS supplyPrice, od.order_price AS orderPrice, od.order_status AS orderStatus, od.reject_reason AS rejectReason FROM order_details od JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id WHERE od.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY od.ingredient_id

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_at AS orderAt, s.store_name AS storeName,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '대기' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '대기'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '승인' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '거절' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '부분'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '승인' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN '승인'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '거절' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN '거절'
ELSE '부분' END AS orderStatus,
o.app_at AS appAt, MAX(od.store_at) AS storeAt, o.total_price AS totalPrice, u.user_name AS userName
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, s.store_name, o.app_at, o.total_price, u.user_name

SELECT od.order_detail_id AS orderDetailId, i.ingredient_name AS ingredientName, od.order_quantity AS orderQuantity, i.order_unit AS orderUnit, od.supply_price AS supplyPrice, od.order_price AS orderPrice, u.user_name AS userName, od.order_status AS orderStatus, od.manufacture_at AS manufactureAt, od.store_at AS storeAt FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY od.ingredient_id
